name: isolation-analysis-test-71231d7fc4/record-field-default-e.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString and toBalString, but not clone.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:"; the list includes value:cloneWithType but not value:clone.

Supported language features (subset 10) > Expressions: the positive list includes "New expression" and "Anonymous function expression", but does not include object-constructor expressions or typeof expressions.
reason: The case asserts isolation errors in record field defaults, including the default z.clone(). That lang.value operation is outside both supported langlib and method-call lists. The case also contains an object-constructor default and typeof r expressions, absent from the supported expression list. These essential constructs make the whole case a feature assessment even though isolation qualifiers, locks, and ordinary calls are supported.
unsupported_constructs: object-constructor expression used as a record field default
test_design_notes: Negative isolation diagnostics are asserted by @error comments; illegality alone does not make a supported construct out of scope.
